description: 'Analyze writing style from existing blog posts and update the Copilot instructions.'

Read the 10 most recent posts in `_posts/`, identify the consistent writing patterns across them — tone, voice, sentence length, vocabulary choices, narrative conventions, use of personal experience, and how technical content is presented — then update the `### Writing Style` section inside `## Markdown Writing Guidelines` in `.github/copilot-instructions.md` with a concise, specific list of those observed style rules, replacing any placeholder content already there.
